prompt: Jade races Orange around the block
title: The Block Race
irony: Coach Orange only wins the block race when he stops racing it and crosses the line slow, hand in hand with Jade.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning light fills the street; Jade draws a chalk start line around the block.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Jade dares Dad Orange to race round the block; Orange flexes and shouts One more lap.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black cries Bet you can and sets the stakes; loser carries the winner's juice cup home.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Neighbours crowd the curb chanting as Jade and Orange step to the chalk line.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade sprints too fast and gasps for air; Orange zooms past Green's water cup stop.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Orange shouts One more lap and races past the finish while Yellow laughs on her porch.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Jade plods on tired legs while the whole street chants louder by the curb.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Orange stops past the corner, chest heaving, watching Jade's small brave legs pump on.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange drops the sprint plan and turns back to jog the last steps beside Jade.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Orange takes Jade's hand as they cross the chalk line together, slow and proud.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Morning light fills the street; Jade and Orange walk home sharing the juice cup.
